meta.title: Daily FX Reference Rate Update
meta.purpose: Every business day copy the official reference exchange rates from the central bank website into the FX master workbook and the treasury system, then send a confirmation email.

steps.name: Open reference rate page
steps.action: Open the central bank reference rate page
details: Open the central bank's daily reference rate page in the browser. URL: to be provided by Treasury.

steps.name: Read rates
steps.action: Read the rates for EUR, USD, GBP, JPY (per 100) and CNY for today's date
details: Locate the table with the daily reference rates
Verify that the publication date shown on the page equals today's date (BE-01 if not)
Read the rate for each currency in Appendix A
steps.ui_interaction_rationale: reads a table on a web page

steps.name: Validate rates
steps.action: Validate rates against the previous business day
details: Compare each rate with the previous business day's rate in the FX master workbook
If a rate deviates by more than 5%, Treasury must be informed (BR-02). Handling of the run in that case: to be clarified.
decision_points: deviation > 5% -> inform Treasury (stop or continue: to be clarified)

steps.name: Update FX master workbook
steps.action: Append today's rates to FX_Rates_Master.xlsm and run macro RefreshPivots
details: Append one row: Date, EUR, USD, GBP, JPY100, CNY, Source = 'Robot'

steps.name: Enter rates in treasury system
steps.action: Enter the rates in the system
details: Log in to the treasury system and enter the daily rates on the rates maintenance screen
Screen details will be added after a walkthrough with the SME

steps.name: Confirmation email
details: Send an email to treasury-team@nordhorn.example with subject 'FX reference rates <date> published' and the five rates in the body

applications.name: Central bank reference rate page
applications.access: Public website, any browser; URL to be provided by Treasury

applications.name: FX master workbook FX_Rates_Master.xlsm
applications.used_for: Rate history; macro RefreshPivots updates reports

business_rules.text: Rates are stored with 4 decimal places; JPY is quoted per 100 units.
A day-on-day deviation > 5% for any currency must be reported to Treasury.
Only one row per date may exist in sheet Rates.

exceptions.description: Rates for today not yet published

transaction.unit: one daily run processing all currencies in a single pass
transaction.retry_policy: the run either completes or fails as a whole; no queue items

robot_environment.description: Linux serverless robots (Automation Cloud); per IT infrastructure guidelines the process shall run on the Linux serverless robot pool
